mapper.select: select * from t_message_outbox where event_key = #{eventKey} limit 1 for update
select * from t_message_outbox where event_id = #{eventId} limit 1

select * from t_message_outbox where status = 'NEW' or (status = 'FAILED' and next_retry_time is not null and next_retry_time <= now()) or (status = 'SENDING' and (lock_expire_time is null or lock_expire_time <= now())) order by id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update t_message_outbox set status = 'SENDING', locked_by = #{lockedBy}, lock_expire_time = timestampadd(second, #{leaseSeconds}, now()) where id = #{id} and (status = 'NEW' or (status = 'FAILED' and next_retry_time is not null and next_retry_time <= now()) or (status = 'SENDING' and (lock_expire_time is null or lock_expire_time <= now())))

update t_message_outbox set status = 'SENT', sent_at = #{sentAt}, locked_by = null, lock_expire_time = null, next_retry_time = null, last_error = null where id = #{id} and status = 'SENDING' and locked_by = #{lockedBy}

update t_message_outbox set status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_error = #{lastError}, locked_by = null, lock_expire_time = null where id = #{id} and status = 'SENDING' and locked_by = #{lockedBy}
update t_message_outbox set status = 'NEW', retry_count = 0, next_retry_time = null, locked_by = null, lock_expire_time = null, last_error = null where event_id = #{eventId} and status = 'FAILED'
